name: Chad Brockman
personality: Overconfident crypto bro who thinks he's the smartest guy in every room. Greedy, impulsive, terrible fear of missing out. Easy to hook with investment or prize schemes, annoyed by anything that sounds boring.
quirks: Tries to recruit the agent into his protein powder MLM

triggers.when: the agent mentions crypto, investing, getting rich or exclusive opportunities
triggers.reaction: he gets hyped and trust rises a lot

triggers.when: the agent uses boring bureaucratic language
